body.afterScripts:
<script>
    (function () {
      'use strict';

      var activeCountry = 'all';
      var activeTopic = null;

      var countryBtns = Array.prototype.slice.call(document.querySelectorAll('.filter-country-btn'));
      var topicBtns   = Array.prototype.slice.call(document.querySelectorAll('.filter-topic-btn'));
      var sections    = Array.prototype.slice.call(document.querySelectorAll('.application-section'));

      function applyFilter() {
        var ukSection = document.getElementById('uk-section');
        var saSection = document.getElementById('sa-section');

        // Show/hide entire country blocks
        if (ukSection) ukSection.style.display = (activeCountry === 'all' || activeCountry === 'uk') ? '' : 'none';
        if (saSection) saSection.style.display = (activeCountry === 'all' || activeCountry === 'sa') ? '' : 'none';

        // Show/hide topic sections within the visible country block
        sections.forEach(function (s) {
          s.style.display = (!activeTopic || s.dataset.topic === activeTopic) ? '' : 'none';
        });

        // Show/hide topic chips: only visible when a single country is selected
        topicBtns.forEach(function (b) {
          b.style.display = (activeCountry !== 'all' && b.dataset.forCountry === activeCountry) ? '' : 'none';
        });
      }

      countryBtns.forEach(function (btn) {
        btn.addEventListener('click', function () {
          activeCountry = btn.dataset.country;
          activeTopic   = null;
          countryBtns.forEach(function (b) { b.classList.remove('is-active'); });
          btn.classList.add('is-active');
          topicBtns.forEach(function (b) { b.classList.remove('is-active'); });
          applyFilter();
        });
      });

      topicBtns.forEach(function (btn) {
        btn.addEventListener('click', function () {
          var t = btn.dataset.topic;
          if (activeTopic === t) {
            activeTopic = null;
            btn.classList.remove('is-active');
          } else {
            activeTopic = t;
            topicBtns.forEach(function (b) { b.classList.remove('is-active'); });
            btn.classList.add('is-active');
          }
          applyFilter();
        });
      });

      // Set initial state
      applyFilter();
    }());
    </script>

  </body>
</html>
